subject.title: RFC 0016: CLI catalog view for command surfaces

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed narrow core catalog contract, redirect cataloging to plugin or derived tooling, or decline the capability for now?
rationale: The RFC introduces a durable public CLI/JSON boundary and source-registry metadata semantics whose ownership and compatibility policy cannot be inferred from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Narrow core catalog
options.body: Approve only the minimum versioned read-only JSON contract and defer richer lenses and public SDK commitments.

options.title: Plugin or derived tooling
options.body: Keep the core public surface unchanged and implement inventory through existing extensibility or repository tooling.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Leave the RFC unaccepted until a concrete core consumer and ownership model justify the compatibility cost.

recommendation.title: Narrow core catalog
recommendation.body: Approve only the minimum versioned read-only JSON contract and defer richer lenses and public SDK commitments.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the repository RFC lifecycle and are the strongest available owner for deciding whether this draft may advance toward acceptance.
